description: Brought the ewer, moved the cat once, and asked which play it was.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Boiled the ink and named the twopence, the threepence, and the short loaf.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Already gone to Norton Folgate. He did not speak.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Named by Alse, for the day he wore the gown. He was not in the house.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Kept the morning for the desk and left the horn half full.
name: William Shakespeare
